Molewhisker seems to be pleased by your answer.  "Well, I have a few that come to mind- maybe *the legend of Firestar*, or *the one time all the dogs showed up*- surely you've heard of this one, but maybe *Softbreeze's vision*.

"The classic! Alright then." Molewhisker grinned with a bit of cheer "This tale goes back to the start of the clans. Before we lived here, you see, the clans lived in a paradise far away. But after many generations, an evil RiverClan leader rose to power. Only ThunderClan's leader, Firestar, could stand against him.

Molewhisker continued, "After the RiverClan leader nearly killed off all of WindClan, ShadowClan joined RiverClan to save their own hides. But Firestar refused to bend to the evil leader's will and battled with RiverClan. ShadowClan was split in two, some fighting for RiverClan and others for Firestar."

"Firestar and his cats won in the end. The leader could not hope to beat him. StarClan refused grant him his nine lives as leader. After Firestar gutted him, the forest was freed and he ruled for many seasons, eventually leading the clans here."
He nodded. "Yes, dogs. Like foxes, but bigger and fiercer. It happened before you were born- only my old bones remember." He gave a wry smile that soon faded.

"They killed many. Invaded RiverClan camp- we heard of it at the gathering and I talked with Frogsplash about his brother-" He looked away... "I'm sorry. I thought I could tell this story after so long, but I guess not. Maybe another time."

He leaned in, his eyes sparkling. "Softbreeze was a WindClan medicine cat, once just as ordinary as you. But then, one fateful moon, she received a vision, a prophecy....one that has not been fullfilled. After she received it, she was apparently so traumatized that she did live long after. But she was very old."
"One..." Molewhisker stopped and murmured to himself. "I'm terribly sorry, I just had to make sure I remembered it right." Molewhisker clears his throat.
It goes, "Fire from thunder will fill the forests with ash
water will boil and
in the turmoil, the others will flee
leaving smoke behind to suffocate the trees."
Molewhisker scoffed, "All it has done is made the other clans wary of ThunderClan! I think she just didn't like us and in bitterness left us with this fake prophecy before her death."
Molewhisker laughs at your comment. "Why, yes. It does sound quite outlandish. Even with Softbreeze having the vision a season ago, nothing has happened. ...*I* bet it's fake.
"Ah, well...I'm sure you'll want to hear them another time. Come back later whenever you want to hear them."

The "command" variable is what the player selects. For example, if the player clicks "Pie" and then clicks "Eat", the command will be set to "Eat Pie".

Most commands have specific responses, as shown here. Some responses change the area using the "area" variable, add an item to your inventory using the "inv" list, or affect your progress using the "progress" list. You can even affect character stats using the "health" and "energy" variables. These variables can be used to change the responses. (For example, you can't enter the castle until "read scroll" is added to the "progress" list.)
